deployments_detail.use: "ChatABC" financial LLM (v1.0 Mar 2023, internal-employee Q&A + auto ticket reply); "AI+" innovation program w/ dedicated Smart Banking office; AI in risk/fraud & customer service

ChatABC (Chinese name 小数/Xiaoshu), the bank's in-house financial large language model — the first self-developed ChatGPT-style AI large model in the Chinese banking industry. A hundred-billion-parameter model built with supervised fine-tuning, RLHF, self-instruct and retrieval-augmented generation over the bank's financial knowledge base; serves as the foundation for internal Q&A, knowledge fusion and a Model-as-a-Service layer. [Self-developed (Agricultural Bank of China AI R&D team)]

Internal deployment of the full DeepSeek large-model series across the bank, applied to smart office (智慧办公) and smart marketing (智慧营销). Confirmed by president Wang Zhiheng at the 2024 annual results conference, who said the bank completed deployment with 'preliminary good results'. [DeepSeek]

Automated work-order / ticket handling assistant (工单自动化 / 自动回复助手) powered by ChatABC, generating automatic replies to internal service tickets and staff inquiries to speed up operations. [Self-developed (ChatABC)]

AgBank AI-themed credit card bundling access to Moonshot AI's Kimi assistant — agent quota, Kimi Code quotas and agent-cluster functionality — granting cardholders LLM/AI productivity benefits. [Moonshot AI (Kimi)]

95599 intelligent voice robot for remote customer service, using NLP and big-data analytics to answer high-frequency, simple inquiries precisely and to match customer intent to the right agent skill ('一说即转' one-utterance routing) via a customer-tagging data platform.
deployments_detail.value: remote banking phone connection rate 96.31% (2023); in-time resolution rate 99.96%
